stopped_body: {source}: {reason}. Nothing more is read until you resume it; ask for its status first.
off: History import is off: set kb.history.enabled to true in manager.json and list the sources under kb.history.sources.
no_sources: kb.history.sources lists no source to import from.
set_needs_source: Name the source whose plan to change.
resume_needs_source: Name the source to start or resume.
plan_unreadable: The plan of {source} could not be read or saved.
refresh_stopped: The list was not refreshed: the import is stopped.
refresh_running: The list was not refreshed while the import is running.
unavailable: {source} cannot import history now: it is not adding to the knowledge base, or it cannot read its history.
refresh_failed: The list could not be refreshed ({code}); this is the plan as it was.
plan_changed: {count} chats would be read more than you approved (new chats, or a changed selection), so the plan needs your approval again.
plan_not_approved: Not approved: nothing is imported until you say to start.
set_unknown: No chat in the plan has the id or the exact name "{chat}". Nothing was changed.
stop_done: History import stopped. It makes no further call until you resume it.
resume_no_plan: {source} has no plan yet: list it first and check it.
resume_done: {source}: plan approved. The import starts within a minute at its usual pace.
resume_done_slow: {source}: plan approved. The import starts within a minute, at the slowest pace for the first two hours.
needs_index: It waits for the knowledge base's search index; set needs_search_index to false for this source to import before it exists.
status_stop_file: Stopped ({reason}, {at}): nothing is read until it is resumed.
status_progress: Chats: {done} done, {todo} to go, {paused} paused, {errors} in error, {unreadable} unreadable · {read} messages read, {written} written.
plan_changed_body: {source}: {count} chats would now be read more than you approved (new chats, or a changed selection). List the plan, check it and approve it again.
refresh_waiting: The list was not refreshed: the source is resting or paused until {at}.
refresh_stopped_now: Refreshing the list stopped the import ({reason}); nothing more is asked until you resume it.
status_slow_pending: Slowest pace for the first two hours once it starts.
reason_very_slow_twice: two very slow calls within {minutes} minutes ({method} took {ms} ms)
reason_pause_too_long: paused for more than {hours} hours without a call going through ({code})
reason_state_unreadable: the import state of chat {chat} does not read
reason_state_save_failed: the import state could not be saved ({class})
reason_anchors_unreadable: the gathered anchors do not read
reason_anchors_save_failed: the gathered anchors could not be saved ({class})
reason_plan_save_failed: the plan could not be saved ({class})
reason_call_timeout: {method} timed out ({code}); whether it was done is unknown
reason_call_connection_closed: the connection closed during {method}; whether it was done is unknown
reason_not_ready_after_call: the source turned not ready right after a call ({method})
reason_source_pace: the source asked to wait {seconds} s
reason_very_slow: very slow: {method} took {ms} ms (over {limit} ms); resting {minutes} minutes
reason_slow_repeated: {count} slow calls among the last {of} ({method} took {ms} ms); resting {minutes} minutes, then the slowest pace
reason_plan_changed: {count} chats would be read more than approved
group_personal: Only your messages and mentions ({count} chats, about {messages} messages):
set_unknown_close: No chat in the plan has the id or the exact name "{chat}". Close names: {candidates}. Nothing was changed.
set_ambiguous: {count} chats are named "{chat}" (ids {ids}): name one by its id. Nothing was changed.
set_invalid: "{chat}": give read (true or false), or reset; store needs read. Nothing was changed.
set_refused: The selection refused the change ({detail}). Nothing was changed.
set_revoked: This reads more than you approved, so the plan needs your approval again before the import goes on.
back_days_invalid: back_days is a number of days, or null. Nothing was changed.
plan_back_rules: Goes back as far as each rule keeps messages.
selection_unavailable: The knowledge base's selection cannot be read right now, so nothing was listed, approved or changed. Try again in a minute.
state_selection_unavailable: waiting for the selection to read
reason_selection_unavailable: the selection could not be read; the approval is kept
